title: Tariff Calculation Note on Repricing an Aged Quote for the Metal Market
content:
# Tariff Calculation Note on Repricing an Aged Quote for the Metal Market

A quote on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is rebuilt for a movement in the metal market once the price behind it has aged past the programme's revaluation window in calendar days, counted from the day the studio's own clock for the quote starts running to the day the repricing is booked.

On the programmes that pass the metal market through, the movement is charged as the studio's escalation of the quoted total for each whole period of thirty calendar days by which the price has aged past the revaluation window, together with the sourcing uplift on a stone sourced to order, and the two are added together before the share passed on and the relief for a late start are taken; on the programmes that do not, the chain absorbs it and no adjustment is booked.

## 1. Counting the periods

The days the price has aged are counted in whole calendar days from the day the studio's clock for the quote starts, that day counting as day zero, weekends and market holidays included, to the day the repricing is booked; the window is taken off them, and what remains is never fewer than none; the whole periods of thirty calendar days inside it are counted, and a part period is not counted.

The studio's clock for the quote starts on the date the metal price behind the quote was taken.

## 2. The escalation

The escalation is 0.6 per cent of the quoted total for each such period.

## 3. The sourcing uplift

The sourcing uplift is taken on the charge for a stone upgrade booked to the commission where one stands, and on the quoted total where none stands. Nothing is added for the sourcing of the centre stone: the uplift is taken at 0 per cent of whichever of those two the uplift is taken on.

## 4. The share passed on and the relief

The whole of the movement is passed on: 100 per cent of the sum of the escalation and the sourcing uplift. The figure reached stands as it is: it is taken at 1, the whole of itself.

## 5. Rounding

The escalation and the sourcing uplift are each rounded half up to two decimal places as they are worked out, and the figure booked is rounded half up to two decimal places once the share passed on and the relief have been applied to their sum.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A Design Studio Custom Setting commission, whose programme holds the metal price for 30 calendar days and passes the metal market through. The metal price behind the quote was taken on the 1st of January and the repricing is booked on the 16th of April, 105 calendar days later. The quoted total is USD 15000.00 and no charge for a stone upgrade stands on the commission.

| Step | Worked |
|---|---|
| Days the price has aged, less the window | 105 less 30, that is 75 |
| Whole periods of thirty calendar days inside 75 | 2; the remaining 15 days are a part period and are not counted |
| The escalation | 0.6 per cent of USD 15000.00, for each of 2 periods, that is USD 180.00 |
| The sourcing uplift | 0 per cent of USD 15000.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| The two added together | USD 180.00 |
| The share passed on | 100 per cent of USD 180.00, that is USD 180.00 |
| Taken at 1 and rounded half up to two decimal places | USD 180.00 |
